name: True Resurrection

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: diamonds worth 25,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: a dead creature you touch, or one you name

summary: Bring back a creature dead up to 200 years (not of old age) with all its Hit Points, even with no body left.
text: It closes wounds, ends poisons, diseases and curses, restores lost parts and returns an Undead to its living form. If the body is gone, you speak the creature's name and it appears in a new body within 10 feet of you.
